leavepulse.title: LeavePulse - SaaS platform
leavepulse.summary: A ~40-service platform built single-handedly: a typed public BFF over a gRPC service mesh, hybrid RBAC/JWT auth, dual realtime websocket gateways, billing with payment-provider webhooks, and ClickHouse-backed observability.
points: Typed public BFF (Litestar + msgspec) generating its own OpenAPI over an internal gRPC mesh
Auth: hybrid RBAC + JWT/JWKS, Argon2id with peppering, Snowflake IDs, short-lived websocket handshake tokens
Auth service also owns token exchange, JWT introspection, JWKS distribution and audience-scoped WebSocket credentials for high-risk paths
Two realtime gateways (client + agent) with a Discord-style handshake and NATS JetStream fan-out
Fleet/control separates desired releases from observed host state, with pinned internal gRPC contracts and an enrolled Rust control agent
Billing with merchant-API integration, webhooks, subscriptions and event-driven order lifecycle
Cross-platform desktop launcher in Rust + Tauri 2 + Vue 3, with an xtask monorepo and Android target
SDK-first: a public contract package with generated SDKs in Python, TypeScript and Rust
Designed a LeaveHosting overlay network around stable participant addresses, WireGuard and BGP routing; implementation is staged after the control and billing planes

cursio.title: Cursio - one workspace across machines
cursio.summary: A LAN-only mesh for trusted personal devices. Input, audio, clipboard, windows, files and USB travel through one encrypted channel, while applications stay on their original host.
points: No hub or server: every peer both listens and reconnects, so one machine going offline does not interrupt the rest of the mesh
SPAKE2 pairing establishes trust without sending the password; later traffic rides a Noise-encrypted link with separate control, input, audio, video and bulk priorities
Cross-platform modules cover shared input, per-application audio, clipboard formats and images, remote windows, disk mounts, USB/IP and an AirPlay receiver
Signed mesh-distributed updates install side by side and roll back if the new build does not start

sdkgen.title: Multi-language SDK generator
sdkgen.summary: A contract-first toolchain (in Rust) that reads the platform's OpenAPI specs and realtime manifest, builds an intermediate representation, and emits a typed, resource-object SDK for TypeScript, Python and Rust at once - plus a reference of the object graph.
points: parser → IR → emitters: one source of truth, three idiomatic client libraries
Fully automated pipeline (cargo xtask): snapshot, regenerate, publish to per-language repos - idempotent and offline
Five auth methods (device flow, PATs, OAuth2 + PKCE, service tokens, cookie login) and a Nuxt transport with SSR cookies, CSRF and refresh-on-401

toolkit.title: Service infrastructure toolkit
toolkit.summary: A public, reusable Python library that every backend service in the platform is built on - the shared layer for observability, gRPC, resilience and caching, so each service ships production-grade plumbing for free.
points: Observability: Prometheus instrumentation, structured request-scoped logging, SQLAlchemy slow-query logging, OpenTelemetry tracing with OTLP auto-instrumentation
gRPC helpers (shared channels, metrics/JWT/internal-token interceptors, error translation), Redis rate limiting and a TTL cache with in-flight dedup and Redis fallback
Packaged with optional extras and CLI code generators - a real internal platform tool, not glue code

magicutils.title: MagicUtils - Minecraft toolkit
magicutils.summary: A published, multi-platform Java/Kotlin library (300+ source files) with its own Maven repository and docs. The shared foundation other plugins build on - including the LeavePulse agent.
points: One toolkit across Bukkit/Paper, BungeeCord, Velocity, Fabric and NeoForge
Modular: config (YAML/TOML), commands (incl. Brigadier), localisation, HTTP clients, placeholders, logging
Distributed via a self-hosted Maven repo under dev.ua.theroer with generated documentation

agent.title: LeavePulse server agent
agent.summary: The on-server side of the platform: a multi-platform Minecraft agent (190+ Java files) that streams privacy-aware telemetry and whitelist events to the backend over HTTP and websockets.
points: Bukkit/Paper, BungeeCord/Waterfall, Velocity, Fabric and NeoForge from a shared core
Whitelist enforcement (kick/restrict), playtime tracking, in-game account linking
Auto-update by channel with SHA-256 validation and Ed25519-signed manifests

uikit.title: Token-driven Vue UI kit
uikit.summary: The component library this very site is built on: ~40 accessible Vue components, a runtime theme engine that re-skins everything from a JSON token set, built on Tailwind v4, reka-ui and motion-v.
points: Runtime theming - themes are plain JSON, applied live to CSS variables
Accessible primitives on reka-ui with tailwind-variants for typed styling
Shipped as a versioned, tree-shakeable ESM package with generated types
